title: Describe a Weekend Activity
wrap_friend: Good. You described a weekend activity with short A2-level past-time details.
learner_goal: Describe one or two simple things you did on the weekend.
register_notes: English A2 friend/social register: broad everyday spoken English, warm but not intimate, no stiff service wording or date pressure.
support_text: Tell a friend what you did on the weekend with one or two short details.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: What did you do on the weekend?
turns.speak: What did you do on the weekend?

choices.surface: I met a friend and had lunch.
choices.translation: 我見了朋友，也吃了午餐。
choices.speak: I met a friend and had lunch.

choices.surface: I will meet a friend tomorrow.
choices.speak: I will meet a friend tomorrow.
choices.feedback: Your friend asked about the past weekend.

choices.surface: Which platform should I go to?
choices.speak: Which platform should I go to?
choices.feedback: This is not a transport question.

choices.surface: We met at a cafe near my home.
choices.translation: 我們在我家附近的咖啡店見。
choices.speak: We met at a cafe near my home.

choices.surface: Should we meet at a cafe?
choices.speak: Should we meet at a cafe?
choices.feedback: You are talking about a past activity.
This is not a hotel problem.

choices.surface: Yes, it was quiet and nice.
choices.speak: Yes, it was quiet and nice.

choices.surface: It made me think about society.
choices.speak: It made me think about society.
choices.feedback: That is too abstract for this A2 exchange.
This is not a refund situation.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Sounds nice. Maybe I can join next time.
turns.speak: Sounds nice. Maybe I can join next time.
turns.translation: 聽起來不錯。也許下次我可以一起去。

choices.surface: Sure, let’s go together next time.
choices.speak: Sure, let’s go together next time.

choices.surface: Get off at the next station.
choices.speak: Get off at the next station.

choices.feedback: This is not a document task.

feedback: Distractors test social register, time/function/domain contrast, and A2 boundary without offering valid alternate answers.
